contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 3
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the accepted TASK-0122 visual dashboard implementation and all prior successful execution evidence; independently validate Rework 3.

On every URL findingId change, including popstate, Back and Forward, atomically reset all Finding-dependent AI Explanation, Threat Intelligence, linked-Incident, loading, error and derived detail state before data for the new Finding may be used.
Remove implicit first-Finding selection completely: do not use loadedFindings[0]; without an exact valid URL findingId selectedFinding remains null and no Finding details are shown.
FindingsWorkspace writes only IDs belonging to its canonically loaded Findings into /findings?findingId=<encoded ID>.
Sidebar transports a present URL findingId to /?findingId=<encoded ID> without claiming or implementing canonical Finding validation.
Dashboard remains the fail-closed canonical validation boundary; an unknown or manipulated findingId displays no data belonging to another Finding.

Add a real routed integration test covering Finding selection, visible Sidebar Dashboard navigation, exact active Dashboard Finding, browser Back with reset and URL-matching dependent detail state, and Forward restoring the exact Dashboard Finding.
Keep direct deep links and Dashboard without findingId truthful and URL-authoritative, and keep the non-functional Dashboard search control absent.
Do not alter the accepted visual TASK-0122 implementation, introduce synthetic data, provider execution, backend changes, another routing architecture or broader product lifecycle behavior.
Run the complete frontend regression, TypeScript validation, production build and git diff --check; publish REVIEW only after every validator passes.
